description: API-side fixes (independent of FEAT-002, which is web-only). Covers HIGH-3, HIGH-2, MEDIUM-2, MEDIUM-1, MEDIUM-3, MEDIUM-4. HIGH-3 and HIGH-2 both edit auth.routes.ts and auth.ts so they are done together and in order. No backend schema change; the FormStatus CLOSED enum and the questionTypeSchema/QuestionType union already exist.
steps: HIGH-3 (cookie name single source of truth): In apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts add `import { env } from "../config/env.js";` and change `let token = req.cookies?.qivo_session;` to `let token = req.cookies?.[env.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME];`. Keep the Bearer-header fallback exactly as-is (Bearer stays primary/accepted).

HIGH-3 (routes): In apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.routes.ts add `import { env } from "../../config/env.js";` and replace every literal "qivo_session" (the clearCookie in logout and the res.cookie in signup/login/google) with env.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME.

HIGH-2 (remove dead cookie code): In apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.routes.ts delete the three `res.cookie(env.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, result.sessionToken, getSessionCookieOptions());` lines (signup, login, google) and the `res.clearCookie(env.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, getClearCookieOptions());` line in logout. Then remove the now-unused `import { getClearCookieOptions, getSessionCookieOptions } from "../../config/cookie.js";`. Do NOT delete apps/api/src/config/cookie.ts. Do NOT touch cookie-parser or any CSRF/origin middleware. In apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts KEEP the cookie-read fallback (now via env.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME) — do not remove it. Before editing, re-read the three handlers and logout to confirm login/signup/google return `token: result.sessionToken` in the JSON body and logout deletes the session via logout(req.sessionId); only then remove the cookie code.

MEDIUM-2 (SESSION_DAYS from env): In apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts remove `const SESSION_DAYS = 30;`, add `import { env } from "../../config/env.js";`, and change createSessionExpiry() to use `env.SESSION_DAYS` in place of SESSION_DAYS. Do the identical change in apps/api/src/modules/auth/google.service.ts.

MEDIUM-1 (closeDueForms sweep): In apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.ts add an exported `closeDueForms(now: Date = new Date()): Promise<number>` mirroring publishDueForms — findMany where `{ deletedAt: null, status: "PUBLISHED" }` selecting `{ id, schema }`, filter to forms whose `getFormSchema(f.schema).settings.scheduledCloseAt` parses to a valid Date `<= now`, then `prisma.form.updateMany({ where: { id: { in: dueIds } }, data: { status: "CLOSED" } })` and return `result.count` (return 0 if dueIds empty). Leave the existing per-request close check in submitFormResponse as a safety net. In apps/api/src/server.ts import closeDueForms alongside publishDueForms and invoke it in the same timer tick — extend runPublishSweep to also call closeDueForms and log the closed count when > 0.
MEDIUM-3 (template phone type): In apps/api/src/modules/forms/templates.ts, inside the event-registration template, change the "Phone Number" question's `type: "SHORT_TEXT"` to `type: "PHONE"`.

MEDIUM-4 (remove as any, type-safe): In apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.ts add `export` to the existing `type QuestionType = ...` union. In apps/api/src/modules/forms/templates.ts import `import type { QuestionType } from "./form.service.js";` and change `TemplateQuestion.type` from `string` to `QuestionType`. In apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.routes.ts /from-template handler change `type: q.type as any,` to `type: q.type,`. Do MEDIUM-3 before/with this so all template types satisfy the union.
acceptance_criteria: In c:/Qivo/apps/api, `pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit` exits 0.
auth.ts and auth.routes.ts reference env.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME and contain no hardcoded "qivo_session" literal.
auth.routes.ts no longer calls res.cookie/res.clearCookie and no longer imports cookie.js; login/signup/google still return token in the JSON body; logout still calls logout(req.sessionId).
auth.service.ts and google.service.ts have no local `const SESSION_DAYS = 30;` and use env.SESSION_DAYS.
form.service.ts exports closeDueForms; server.ts calls it in the sweep; CLOSED matches the Prisma enum.
templates.ts event-registration phone field type is PHONE; TemplateQuestion.type is QuestionType; form.routes.ts has no `as any` in the /from-template question mapping.
verification: cd c:/Qivo/apps/api && pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit  (expect exit 0, no errors)
Re-read apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.routes.ts to confirm token is returned in the response body for signup/login/google and logout deletes the session (HIGH-2 safety).
findings:
All six steps implemented; `pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit` in apps/api exits 0.

HIGH-3: middleware/auth.ts now imports env and reads req.cookies?.[env.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME]; Bearer-header fallback kept as primary. No hardcoded 'qivo_session' literal remains in src except the env.ts default.

HIGH-2 safety outcome: SAFE TO REMOVE COOKIE CODE. Re-read signup/login/google handlers in auth.routes.ts — all three return `token: result.sessionToken` in the JSON response body (data.token), and logout calls `logout(req.sessionId)` which deletes the DB session via prisma.session.deleteMany. The cookie was NOT the sole token-delivery mechanism, so the three res.cookie(...) calls and the logout res.clearCookie(...) were removed, and the now-unused `import { getClearCookieOptions, getSessionCookieOptions } from "../../config/cookie.js";` was removed. apps/api/src/config/cookie.ts was NOT deleted; cookie-parser and CSRF/origin middleware untouched. The cookie-read fallback in middleware/auth.ts was kept (now via env.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME). NOTE: env import was intentionally NOT added to auth.routes.ts because after HIGH-2 removed all cookie calls there is no env usage there, and an unused import fails under the strict tsconfig; a short reference comment was added instead.

MEDIUM-2: removed `const SESSION_DAYS = 30;` from both auth.service.ts and google.service.ts, added `import { env } from "../../config/env.js";` to each, and createSessionExpiry() now uses env.SESSION_DAYS.

MEDIUM-1: form.service.ts now EXPORTS `closeDueForms(now = new Date()): Promise<number>` mirroring publishDueForms (findMany status PUBLISHED + deletedAt null, filters on getFormSchema(f.schema).settings.scheduledCloseAt <= now, updateMany to status CLOSED, returns count, 0 when none). The per-request close check in submitFormResponse was left as a safety net. server.ts imports closeDueForms alongside publishDueForms and runPublishSweep now also calls closeDueForms and logs the closed count when > 0.

MEDIUM-3: event-registration template 'Phone Number' question type changed from SHORT_TEXT to PHONE.

MEDIUM-4: `QuestionType` union in form.service.ts is now EXPORTED. templates.ts imports `import type { QuestionType } from "./form.service.js";` and TemplateQuestion.type is now QuestionType (was string). form.routes.ts /from-template handler no longer uses `as any` (now `type: q.type`), which type-checks because createQuestion's input.type is QuestionType.

For later steps: QuestionType is exported from apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.js; closeDueForms exists there and is wired into server.ts's 60s sweep.
